notes.title: September Update
notes.notes:
This update makes further adjustments to card burning to achieve the following:

[list]
[*] Bring gold production back in balance with hammers
[*] Increase player options on a turn if they're willing to sacrifice cards
[*] Don't require players to burn a card every turn for optimal play
[*] Maintain the slower overall progression and rewards for planning from the last patch
[/list]

Rule Changes
[list]
[*] Card burns now always yield 1 hammer (except Firewood)
[*] Firewood cards are initially called "Timber" and turn into Firewood next turn
[*] Timber burns like any other card, Firewood burns for 2 hammers and 1 science
[*] Starting deck includes 1 Firewood and 1 Timber
[*] Lumbermills built on same hex multiple times by same player will not give additional Timber
[/list]

UI
[list]
[*] Civ selection changes so you can view info for your currently selected civ
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where using Mass Produce and then Lumbermill would result in Lumbermill card being drawn instead of Firewood/Timber
[*] Fixed an issue where city growth text from Capital placement could appear off screen
[*] Fixed an issue where hex detail popups would appear when score screen is in foreground
[/list]

Misc
[list]
[*] Various performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: August Update - Balance and New Rules
notes.notes:
Most of the [b]Experimental Rules[/b] are now implemented in the default game. These changes encourage players to grow their economies through improvements, buildings, and wonders, rather than relying on burning cards. The old game rules are playable with the [b]Legacy Mode[/b] custom game options.

[h3]Rule Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Card burns now give 5 gold for first burn per turn then 4,3,2,1
[*] Firewood burns still give 2 hammers and 1 science
[*] Palace gives 1 more hammer
[*] Mine adds 1 additional hammer to yield
[*] Fishing Hut now also adds 1 gold to yield
[*] Huts are more likely to give science
[*] Hut spawn rates increased
[*] Removed Embark hammer cost
[*] Scout gather hammer cost removed
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Imperial Guard now starts with General promotion instead of Vanguard
[*] Imperial Guard cost reduced to 9 hammers
[*] General Promotion now buffs nearby units immediately when applied and at start of each turn
[*] Mamluk gold cost increased to 6
[*] Removed shuffle gold cost reduction from China
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where camera would sometimes not automatically pan to attacks on your units
[*] Fixed an issue where map generation could fail in multiplayer games with large player counts
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the game would stop responding when quitting
[/list]

notes.title: March Update
notes.notes:
This update includes an option to use some new experimental rules for single-player skirmish and custom multiplayer games. The experimental rules are intended to change some of the incentives for burning cards in your deck and slightly extend the duration of games.

[h3]Experimental Rules[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can enable "Experimental Rules" for Skirmish and custom multiplayer games
[*] Card burns now give 4 gold for first burn per turn then 3,2,1
[*] Firewood burns still give 2 hammers and 1 science
[*] Palace gives 1 additional hammer
[*] Mine adds 1 additional hammer to yield
[*] Scout gather hammer cost removed
[*] Huts are more likely to give science
[*] Hut spawn rates increased
[/list]


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error in the Player Explorer
[*] Fixed an error that could occur with citizens when a city is pillaged
[/list]

notes.title: February Update
notes.notes:
This update includes significant improvements to several mid and late game cards. Several were not powerful enough to justify the cost of reaching them in the tech tree or to not almost always burn them in favor of playing other cards. They were also rarely being used by players according to our analytics.

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Mass Produce[/b] - Now always drawn at start of your turn if it is in your deck
[*] [b]Annex[/b] - Also claims all unclaimed hexes adjacent to target hex. Cost increased to 10 gold
[*] [b]Courthouse[/b] - Now also produces 4 gold. Culture production increased to 4
[*] [b]Garrison Promotion[/b] - Now produces 2 happiness in a city and reduces maintenance cost by more. Defense bonus increased slightly
[*] [b]Craftsmanship [/b]- Now also gives 1 gold per building or improvement. Roads no longer count. Range reduced to 2.
[*] [b]Pathfinder Promotion[/b] - Now also removes terrain movement penalty for unit itself
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bots are now less likely to use military units to claim hexes with no resources
[*] Units that already have orders are greyed out in selection window 
[*] Added effect when a unit is captured
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Captured warships in a city can no longer capture or burn the city
[*] Fixed an issue where Frenzy ability would default to using hammers instead of luxury
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer where Annex could be used on a Holy Site next to an enemy settler but it would not actually claim it
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer where embarked Settlers could block claiming neighboring Holy Sites
[*] Fixed an issue where a Barracks could be assigned to a pillaged city making it unusable
[*] Fixed an issue where Granary yield increase wouldn't immediately show after being built
[*] Fixed an issue where yield increases from pillaged improvements and buildings would show until the next turn
[*] Fixed an issue where the Volley suppressed effect could be applied while a unit is defending
[*] Fixed an issue where splash damage was ignoring the Holy Warrior and Immortal effects
[*] Fixed an issue with controller UI navigation after hitting the back button on the campaign card store screen
[/list]

notes.title: October Update - v1.2.1087
notes.notes:
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Settler cost now increases with number of cities
[*] Flank attacks now do 20% splash damage to 1 unit on target hex
[*] Flank attacks cause the attacker to take 75% damage
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Option for a new map when you hit the Retry button in Skirmish mode
[*] Tech tree optimizations
[*] Small changes to a few card illustrations
[*] Internal optimizations that should improve performance
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changes that should reduce the number of blank names on leaderboards
[*] Fixed an issue where double yield resources would show when viewing the map after a game
[*] Fixed an issue where resource icons could flicker when ending your turn
[*] Fixed an issue where resource icons could be arranged incorrectly
[*] Fixed an issue where network latency could cause your hammer and gold count to be temporarily wrong
[*] Fixed an issue where rapidly issuing certain order sequences could cause the flashing disconnect icon to appear
[/list]

notes.title: July Update - v1.2.1020
notes.notes:
[h3]Ladder Season 2 Begins[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ladder rankings reset on July 16, 2024
[*] Your best Season 1 ranking can still be showcased using the distinct Season 1 and Season 2 badges
[/list]


[h3]Level Cap Raised to 100[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various cosmetic rewards added for levels 50 to 100 (Badges, Avatars, Banners, Titles, Pets)
[/list]


[h3]One More Turn...[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players can now choose to continue playing after a single-player game ends
[*] This will not affect your challenge scores, Hegemon scores, or your level progress
[*] Game balance and performance may suffer as the game continues beyond its intended length
[/list]


[h3]Retry Button[/h3]
[list]
[*] Challenge players can rejoice in only having to click 1 Retry button to restart a challenge or any other Single Player game
[*] Retrying a Daily Challenge will count as a challenge attempt
[*] Using the Retry button will use the same map generation seed for skirmish games
[/list]


[h3]Data Collection for Next-Gen AI[/h3]
[list]
[*] We're collecting information on player behavior to experiment with creating a new AI
[*] This data is automatically collected in multiplayer games but is by default not collected during single-player
[*] If you wish to help us out, it can be enabled for single-player in the game menu. Be aware that this could result in a large amount of data being sent to our servers so is not recommended on a metered network connection
[*] This is experimental and in the extremely early stages - it may not lead to a better AI
[/list]


[h3]New Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Beloved - Get 25 We Love You points. Rewards: The Beloved title and Bald Eagle pet
[*] Woodchuck - Control 10 lumbermills. Reward: Beaver pet
[*] Polar Super Power - Control 5 tundra hexes. Reward: Penguin pet
[/list]


[h3]Multiplayer Game Technical Log[/h3]
[list]
[*] A technical log file is now available after a multiplayer game which can be used to discern what actions the other human players took during the game
[*] On Windows the files are located at: C:\Users\<USERNAME>\AppData\LocalLow\Main Tank Software\Hexarchy\player_stats_<GAME_ID>.json
[*] This contains statistics about the game in JSON format - you may need a technical background to make use of it
[/list]


[h3]Misc / Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can now view previous challenge results without completing the current challenge
[*] Warship now correctly gives a Victory Point like Catapult and Cannon
[*] Fixed the Daily Challenge screen Discord button
[/list]

notes.title: The Hexarchy Boats and Vikings Update is Now Live—with a 33% Discount too!
notes.notes:
Hello Hexarchists!

It’s the update you’ve all been waiting for—the boats and Vikings are here! In this update you can enjoy a new unit, a new ability, and even a whole new civilization. PLUS Hexarchy’s going to be on sale with its biggest ever discount of 33% from May 23rd so now’s the time to grab your friends and don your finest horned helmet!

[h3][b]New Naval Unit[/b][/h3]
Watch your back because you and your enemies can now attack from the water with the [b]Warship[/b]! This ranged unit has 7 strength so beware if you’re building your cities on the coast!

[h3][b]New Unit Ability[/b][/h3]
It’s not just the warships that can set sail, use [b]Embark[/b] to turn any unit into a boat that can travel on water! Sneak up on your enemies overseas and discover new lands to conquer.

[h3][b]The Vikings[/b][/h3]
A new civilization is here and their perks pack a punch. The Vikings bring with them the [b]Ulfhednar[/b]—an 8 strength unit that can embark for free from any hex AND the Ulfhednar card gains 1 strength every two turns. The Viking’s ability is [b]FRENZY[/b], this allows you to give a unit 8 strength, charge, and mobilize for one turn all at once! Triple threat!

[h3][b]New worlds[/b][/h3]
Bring your new units and civilisation to new map types; Pangea, Continents, and New World. [b]Pangea[/b] is the classic all one continent with possibility of small surrounding islands to explore. The [b]Continents[/b] map has two or more continents with small islands two—using embark here is a must! The [b]New World[/b] has the same; two or more continents but all players start on the same continent.

[h3][b]Other balance changes[/b][/h3]
As always we are always optimizing Hexarchy’s gameplay so check out the patch notes for more info and the full rundown of changes.

[h3][b]Conquer the continents tournament![/b][/h3]
Hoist the sails, because we're throwing a tournament to celebrate the launch of the new update! All the details can be found on Discord.

To be the first to hear about new info and community events join our Discord.

[h3]Full patch notes[/h3]

[b]New Unit - Warship[/b]
[list]
[*] Ranged naval unit
[*] 7 strength
[*] Unlocks with Astronomy
[/list]

[b]New Ability - Embark[/b]
[list]
[*] Turn a unit into a boat that can travel over water
[*] Requires hex with Harbor in most cases
[*] Costs 1 Hammer
[*] Units that have embarked once can re-embark without a Harbor
[*] Movement bonuses are only 50% effective on embarked units
[/list]

[b]New Civilization - Vikings[/b]
Passive Bonuses:
[list]
[*] When you Embark a unit, draw a card that grants Charge once per turn
[*] Get luxury resources and extra victory points when pillaging
[/list]

[b]Viking Unit - Ulfhednar[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlocks a tech tier 2
[*] 8 strength
[*] Cost 3 Hammer or 2 Luxury
[*] Can Embark for free from any hex
[*] Card gains 1 strength every 2 turns
[/list]

[b]Viking Ability - Frenzy[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlocks at tech tier 3
[*] Cost 3 Hammer or 3 Luxury
[*] For this turn, give a unit +8 Strength, Charge, and Mobilize
[/list]

[b]Multiple Map Types[/b]
[list]
[*] Pangea - classic one continent
[*] Continents - 2 or more continents with bonus islands
[*] New World - 2 or more continents but all players start on the same one
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Jaguar starting strength increased to 5
[*] Scout gather ability always costs 1 hammer
[*] City maintenance over water without harbor reduced
[*] Harbor no longer grants free resources when built
[*] Vanguard cost reduced to 2 Hammers
[*] Military Engineer cost reduced to 1 Hammer
[/list]

[b]Other noteworthy changes[/b]
[list]
[*] "Fast Events" menu option to significantly increase speed at which events play between turns 
[*] New "No Immediate Charges" game setting to disallow Charge attacks for a unit on the turn it was built
[*] Max zoom level increased slightly
[*] New Achievements!
[/list]


[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Pillaged cities no longer block movement on the turn they were pillaged
[*] Fixed an issue where a captured city could permanently say it requires more Gold
[*] Fixed a rare issue that could cause multiplayer co-op matches to hang
[*] Fixed an issue where UI could get messed up when joining for a multiplayer game from a single player score screen
[/list]

notes.title: The Hexarchy CO-OP update is now live - with a 30% Discount starting March 25th!
notes.notes:
Hello,

We are back with a new exciting update! We hope you are ready to grab your most trusted general and join forces against teams of AI! Not only that, but we have also added controller support if you want to take being an armchair general to the next level! - AND that's not all! We will be discounting Hexarchy for the duration of the Steam Deck Builder Fest! Allowing you and your friends to pick up Hexarchy with a 30% discount starting March 25th!

This update adds one of the most anticipated features to the game! The CO-OP update has been in the works for a little while and we hope you enjoy it as much as we do! The update includes:

[h3][b]Multiplayer Cooperative[/b][/h3]
You will now be able to team up with another player to take on 1 or more AI teams, work together to achieve a combined score and win on points, or mount an unstoppable force and march it straight into the enemy lands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39225023/3b1b4044d2b16f353a67a09f68b4cb729317a8ed.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Single Player Teams[/b][/h3]
You will not only be able to play CO-OP with other players but you will also be able to play Singleplayer team games where you can team up with an AI and take on one more AI teams.

[h3][b]Full Controller Support[/b][/h3]
You will also be able to play Hexarchy using your controller of choice! If you want to lay back on the couch and play in comfort, or if you simply just prefer using a controller over keyboard and mouse you now have that option! With our official layout, we recommend using the DPAD for navigation but feel free to experiment with different layouts and let us know your feedback.

[h3][b]Balance changes[/b][/h3]
We are also bringing in a host of balance changes, check out the patch notes below for full details!

Join us on Discord to be the first to hear about our future updates! 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/rySTNdz]DISCORD[/url]

[h1]Patch Notes for Update 1.1.926[/h1]

[h3]New Game Modes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Multiplayer Cooperative[/b] - play on a team with human players against one or more AI teams 
[*] [b]Single Player Teams[/b] - play on a team with other AI players against one or more AI teams
[/list]

[h3]Team Play Rules[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each player still chooses their own civilization
[*] All Wonder bonuses are shared
[*] Cannot build duplicate Wonders with teammates, even on the same turn
[*] Victory points are shared
[*] Victory points required to win are multiplied by number of civilizations per team
[*] Vision is shared with teammates
[*] Cannot attack teammate units or cities
[*] Cannot claim teammate territory
[/list]

[h3]Controller Support[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full controller support without use of mouse and keyboard
[*] Recommend using DPAD for navigation with our official layout but joystick mouse can also be used
[*] More improvements are planned - please give us your feedback
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] All Technology hammer costs increased by 1-2 hammers
[*] Paying to move a citizen makes moving the citizen free for the rest of the turn
[*] AI tweaks
[/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] More multiplayer data usage optimizations that should improve performance
[*] New City, Holy Site, and Hut card illustrations 
[*] Added glow effect to Destroy Card button if no cards destroyed yet this turn
[*] Dotted lines that indicate citizens working hexes are now bold for a city when the city hex is selected
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where building an improvement on a hex would remove Battlefields
[*] Fixed an issue where city pillages would remove nearby Battlefields
[/list]

notes.title: The final Hexarchy playtest ahead of the October 19th release date is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello,

[b]The final weeks are upon us as we head to the October 19th launch date! - You have 1 full week for your final chance to play and provide feedback ahead of launch![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39225023/8dc5ead6ecc4ae4552c46eae7599f7c5c7bab08f.gif[/img]

We have been hard at work adding the finishing touches to Hexarchy and we feel the game has never been in a better position in terms of polish, balance and bugs. the latest patch has added some improvements to gameplay and UI, some bug fixes and some balance changes including some minor nerfs and buffs to even out the strength of a few of the civs. 

Check out the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1356810/view/3719467310648782852]HERE[/url]

If you have participated in the previous playtests you will be automatically granted access to this playtest - but if you're new to Hexarchy, simply head over to our store page and hit the request access button to gain access. The playtest also includes the game's multiplayer, so bring your friends along too.

We hope you enjoy the playtest and please feel free to provide any feedback on the Steam forums or [url=https://discord.gg/rySTNdz]Discord[/url]. We hope to see you all enjoying Hexarchy at launch!

notes.notes:
[h1]Daily Challenge Mode[/h1]
- Every day at 0:00 GMT, a new single-player map and objective will be created
- All players playing the daily challenge will have the exact same map, civilization, start position, objective, and bot difficulty
- Results and new high score announcements are automatically posted to Discord
- Try multiple times to try to improve your score


[h1]Multiplayer Improvements[/h1]
- Can play single-player while queued for a multiplayer game
- Can queue for a multiplayer game from the menu while already in a single-player game
- Multiplayer game results are announced on Discord if at least 2 players in the game are on Discord


[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
- Gold distribution now prioritizes cities before units. This makes it easier to starve enemy armies by cutting supply lines.
- Pillage removes maintenance costs from the pillaging unit for several turns 
- Pillage now gives victory points as well as gold
- Barracks no longer prevents population consumption. Population is consumed from nearest city when building a unit
- Barracks must be built within 3 hexes of a city
- Barracks cost reduced
- Farms now produce 2 wheat instead of 1
- Farm cost increased
- Granary now immediately adds a population to the city and also produces 1 food per turn
- Granary cost increased
- Roads cost more to build on hills and forests
- Cities on hills receive an extra defense bonus
- Catapults can be captured with moves, not just attack advances


[h1]UI Improvements[/h1]
- Many UI widgets moved and resized to be less cluttered
- New art assets for most UI widgets
- Can now right click to issue move orders
- Added toggle button to show all trade routes
- Added toggle button to show all maintenance routes
- Resource cards replaced with tokens
- Discard pile cards are now face up
- Discard pile cards can be viewed by mousing over it
- Cards saved for next turn are listed on mouseover
- Card shuffle animation when your discard pile is shuffled into your deck
- Detailed information panel when you mouseover a city's food and luxury bars
- Detailed information panel when you mouseover your hammers and gold
- Detailed information panel when you mouseover a resource in the trade panel
- Added hex "cards" with information about the selected hex including resources and defense bonuses
- Removed summary panel in the top right
- Unit banners have pips indicating the number of units on a hex
- Units have an indicator under them to make it more apparent what team they are on
- Card description improvements
- Unit cards on the selected hex are now clearly split between units that have orders and units that don't
- Cards that are added by tech cards no longer popup when you mouseover the tech card
- Road building path improvements
- Added screen resolution selection to game menu 


[h1]Graphical Improvements[/h1]
- New farm building
- Added cloud shadows
- Added birds
- Added post processing effects 
- Borders are sharper
- Unit shader changes
- Building size changes


[h1]Bot Improvements[/h1]
- Bots build a lot of things they used to not build
- Bots should be more challenging


[h1]Noteworthy Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where catapults would not always attack when they should have
- Fixed issues with unit attack advances
- Fixed a bug where units could attack mountain and water hexes
- Fixed a texture glitch that could occur during combat animations
- Fixed a bug where units occupying enemy cities would only have 1 gold maintenance
- And many more

[b]Big thanks to ATotalParadox and all of our testers on Discord - especially Rpsaxy, Dragonofdark, Moulefrite, Anoc, Beldat, and Frrfrr[/b]

notes.title: Hexarchy Update 0.250 - All game modes re-enabled
notes.notes:
[h1]All game modes re-enabled[/h1]

All game modes, including single-player, are now re-enabled. Public multiplayer games will be announced on the Discord in the #hexarchy-lfg channel like they used to be.

Any demo players that want to join the alpha test, applications are open on our Discord: https://discord.gg/rySTNdz

Thanks everyone for all your great feedback over the past couple of weeks!

notes.title: Hexarchy Update 0.248 - Single-player Disabled
notes.notes:
[h1]Single-player disabled[/h1]

We've temporarily disabled the single-player mode for the remainder of the free demo. The Play button will automatically queue you for a multiplayer game. If it can't find players, you will automatically be placed in a game with bots.

After the demo ends, join our Discord if you want to become a beta tester!

notes.title: Hexarchy Update 0.220 - UI changes and more
notes.notes:

The UI has been rearranged to improve the experience for players that do not use the keyboard. Scrolling with the mouse has also been improved.

[list]
[*]Many UI elements moved
[*]Drag to scroll with the left mouse button
[*]Added a button that shows the number of units needing orders. Click it to select the next unit
[*]Edge of screen scrolling is no longer blocked by UI components
[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]When creating a public multiplayer game, the game code will be announced in Main Tank Software Discord's #hexarchy-lfg channel. Create a private game if you do not want it announced
[*]Added a mute button for the music on the title screen
[*]Clicking your Civ's portrait at the top of the screen will pan to your capital
[*]Lots of backend server infrastructure improvements
[*]Lots of bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Hexarchy Update 0.184 - Easily Play With Friends
notes.notes:
[h1]Game "Lobbies"[/h1]

Create a game and send your friends a 5 character code so they can easily join it. Send it in a text message, a Steam message, post it on Discord, etc. Mark the game as "Private" if you don't want players without the code to be able to join.

Alternatively, just click the "Find Game" button like before and automatically get matched up with anyone else looking for a game.

[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Scouts can no longer attack cities (this was ripe for griefing)
[*]Added a timeout to the draw card screen in multiplayer games
[/list]
